findings.title: Personal multi-field expansion drops the retained original text-destination publication
findings.reproduction: Capture an actual focus-guard publication for the original field, then change controlled resident focus during actual layout planning. Actual manager/injector single @p refuses with zero writes; combo @np succeeds with 14 recorded writes including backspaces and real Tab to the successor. Healthy controls succeed. Uses synthetic s/e values and recording native ports, not a desktop receiver.
findings.root_cause: manager.on_trigger calls _fire_combo(prefix,t) without publication; _fire_combo calls inject_fields without destination. Injector.inject_fields has no publication parameter and prepares/runs with nil admission. Channel/layout ownership cannot substitute for original focused-field authority.
findings.silent_failure: Combo reports success despite stale publication; privacy log redaction does not prevent wrong-field output. Native transport refusal is a cleanup backstop, but successful writes to the wrong focus produce no warning.
findings.regression_test: Exercise original Main/manager/injector around focus/privacy/pause retirement before first erase and during planning/clipboard settlement, requiring zero writes into successor and complete cleanup. Preserve real Tab continuation using an appropriate form authority rather than requiring the original field after every intentional Tab.
findings.basis: Actual production owners over controlled native resident focus/uinput or page-host receipts; private synthetic filesystem, no native desktop receiving. See role report and root replay receipts.

findings.title: Personal-information source and editor save ignore the effective configuration directory
findings.reproduction: Acknowledge actual Paths.set_config_dir to a private custom directory using real Storage. Seed distinct default/effective personal files, then initialize actual manager without personal_info_path. It loads default and genuine capture/save edits default, leaving effective unchanged. Explicit effective path init loads correct value.
findings.root_cause: manager.init builds default_config_dir()/personal_info.toml instead of ConfigPaths.config personal_info.toml. Production Main init and magic-key callback supply only trigger_char. The public open_personal_info action uses effective Paths.config, creating split source authority.
findings.silent_failure: Initialization/save succeed with no warning against default source while configured-path action opens another file. Reset to default or explicit init path works; production callers do not pass the explicit path.
findings.regression_test: Select actual custom config directory, seed distinct files, execute actual startup/magic-key initialization and editor save, and assert a single effective source. Keep independent bootstrap Storage discovery.

findings.title: Missing first-boot personal-info file prevents editor initialization and source creation
findings.reproduction: Initialize actual manager against absent private source and call genuine editor bridge ready with valid current page epoch. pushed=false, zero init JS and zero initial notices; Save fails and creates no file. Independently create valid source/reinitialize and same page pushes fields. Closed epoch remains refused.
findings.root_cause: Absent parse returns empty tables; capture_info_edit requires existing classified ok file with info table. Bridge ready silently returns on missing receipt, and save requires that receipt. No Linux startup/install/onboarding first-create seed path was found; page renders supplied fields only.
findings.silent_failure: Initial editor refusal emits no init data or notice. A later save is refused, but UI cannot create its source. Manual valid TOML creation and reinitialization are backstops.
findings.regression_test: Add authorized absent-source creation coverage through actual source owner/bridge/writer, including source-appearance races, foreign epochs and write refusal. Preserve absent/stale source admission guards; introduce legitimate first-create authority.
